result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both screenshots show only the idle state, so neither proves how the export behaves during the wait, on cancel, or when it finishes. B does more of what I can see: it has a separate season report panel that tells people up front the export takes about 25 seconds and produces a CSV, and that panel gives the progress status a natural place to appear. A shows only a bare button above the table, though both have plausible sample data and no external assets. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both screenshots show only the idle state, so I couldn't check click response, progress, cancel or completion behaviour for either answer. A gives the export its own card, says it takes about 25 seconds and outputs a CSV, and leaves room for status in place, so it does more to address the 'did anything happen?' problem. B is a clean page with good sample data, but it shows only a bare button with no hint of the wait or where status will appear.
